scope: Replace per-earning-week cash assumptions with exact original-funding-scope liability and immutable whole-cent receipts.

requirements: Integrate with current main and the real reviewed V2 getter/claim backend before any browser publication. A missing getter deliberately blocks claims.
Complete coordinated source, bank, funding and player ownership, common finality and legacy exclusion before the exact capability may report source_active:true.
Keep exact definition pins and the legacy exclusion attestation at the capability boundary; captured records alone do not authorize source claims.
Legacy fn_claim_rakeback must refuse the cutover race. An account that observed captured activation never falls back to that mutation.
No placeholder or bootstrap getter merely to publish this page early.

behavior: Canonical exact decimal strings use BigInt reconciliation; cash strings have exactly two decimals. No earning week is independently rounded into claimable cash.
Compatible closed weeks carry fractions within the original club, Union, funding route, generation and captured payer. Separate payers never mix fractional entitlement.
Funding-pool absence remains visible before bank admission; presence and identity agree across payer balances within the same original pool tuple.

Payment receipts reconcile exactly to scope and global cash totals. Their earning slices reconcile to exact week consumption and preserve original hand/contributor/scope/pool/week identity across partial payments.
Open weeks remain visible but never contribute to closed pending cash. Unresolved source records remain visible without invented entitlement.
The page separates exact earned/allocated/remaining values from dated whole-cent payments, with original Union or Club Funding context.

The immutable request UUID, actor and optional club survive lost responses, reload and schema upgrades in the existing version1 storage envelope. Only validated V2 authoritative receipts clear recovery.
Recovery works with zero pending or unavailable capability. Account and render-session fences suppress stale reads, payout completion, messages and bus events, including A-to-B-to-A.
Zero and partial receipts leave explicit unpaid deferrals visible. A cleanup failure is distinguished from an unconfirmed transfer.
Legacy history remains separate from captured totals. The optional numeric refresh hint is emitted only when cents survive a roundtrip; displayed cash remains exact.

validation.limits: Actual page, hook, service and parser run under React DOM with controlled transport. Three JSON response witnesses with unchanged data come from actual native SQL composition. This is not a live account payout, a browser-to-production network test, activation, or programme completion.
